names: Crown Prince of Wu under Fuchai

sourceDate.text: 夫差賜屬鏤之劍，子胥自剄
楚平王時；伍子胥亡楚奔吳
夫差賜屬鏤之劍，子胥自剄
夫概自立為王旋敗奔楚
鮑牧受子胥子；齊鮑氏殺悼公
子西許白公伐鄭後見殺

units.zh: 伍子胥者，楚人也，名員。
units.en: Wu Zixu was a man from Chu, named Yuan.
units.literal: Wu Zixu was a Chu man, named Yuan.

units.zh: 員父曰伍奢。
units.en: Yuan's father was named Wu She.
units.literal: Yuan's father was named Wu She.

units.zh: 員兄曰伍尚。
units.en: Yuan's elder brother was named Wu Shang.
units.literal: Yuan's elder brother was named Wu Shang.

units.zh: 其先曰伍舉，以直諫事楚莊王，有顯，故其後世有名於楚。
units.en: His ancestor was named Wu Ju, who served King Zhuang of Chu with upright remonstration and gained prominence. His descendants therefore became famous in Chu.
units.literal: His ancestor was named Wu Ju, who served King Zhuang of Chu with upright remonstration, gained prominence, therefore his descendants were famous in Chu.

units.zh: 楚平王有太子名曰建，使伍奢為太傅，費無忌為少傅。
units.en: King Ping of Chu had a crown prince named Jian. He made Wu She Grand Tutor and Fei Wuji Junior Tutor.
units.literal: King Ping of Chu had a crown prince named Jian, made Wu She grand tutor, Fei Wuji junior tutor.

units.zh: 無忌不忠於太子建。
units.en: Fei Wuji proved disloyal to Crown Prince Jian.
units.literal: Wuji was not loyal to Crown Prince Jian.

units.zh: 平王使無忌為太子取婦於秦，秦女好，無忌馳歸報平王曰：「秦女絕美，王可自取，而更為太子取婦。」
units.en: King Ping sent Wuji to take a wife for the crown prince from Qin. The Qin woman was beautiful, so Wuji galloped back to report to King Ping, saying: 'The Qin woman is exceptionally beautiful. The king can take her himself and get another wife for the crown prince.'
units.literal: King Ping sent Wuji to take a wife for the crown prince from Qin, the Qin woman was beautiful, Wuji galloped back to report to King Ping saying: 'The Qin woman is exceptionally beautiful, the king can take her himself, and get another wife for the crown prince.'

units.zh: 平王遂自取秦女而絕愛幸之，生子軫。
units.en: King Ping then took the Qin woman himself and doted on her exclusively. She gave birth to a son named Zhen.
units.literal: King Ping then took the Qin woman himself and doted on her exclusively, gave birth to son Zhen.

units.zh: 更為太子取婦。
units.en: He got another wife for the crown prince.
units.literal: Got another wife for the crown prince.

units.zh: 無忌既以秦女自媚於平王，因去太子而事平王。
units.en: Wuji, having used the Qin woman to curry favor with King Ping, then left the crown prince and served King Ping.
units.literal: Wuji having used the Qin woman to curry favor with King Ping, then left the crown prince and served King Ping.

units.zh: 恐一旦平王卒而太子立，殺己，乃因讒太子建。
units.en: He feared that once King Ping died and the crown prince ascended, he would kill him, so he slandered Crown Prince Jian.
units.literal: Feared that once King Ping died and the crown prince ascended, he would kill him, so slandered Crown Prince Jian.

units.zh: 建母，蔡女也，無寵於平王。
units.en: Jian's mother was a woman from Cai, and she had no favor with King Ping.
units.literal: Jian's mother was a Cai woman, had no favor with King Ping.

units.zh: 平王稍益疏建，使建守城父，備邊兵。
units.en: King Ping gradually grew more distant from Jian. He made Jian guard Chengfu and prepare the border troops.
units.literal: King Ping gradually grew more distant from Jian, made Jian guard Chengfu, prepare border troops.

units.zh: 頃之，無忌又日夜言太子短於王曰：「太子以秦女之故，不能無怨望，願王少自備也。
units.en: After a while, Wuji again spoke day and night of the crown prince's faults to the king, saying: 'Because of the Qin woman's matter, the crown prince is bound to harbor resentment. I wish the king would prepare himself slightly.
units.literal: After a while, Wuji again day and night spoke of the crown prince's faults to the king, saying: 'Because of the Qin woman's matter, the crown prince cannot but harbor resentment. I wish the king would prepare himself slightly.

units.zh: 自太子居城父，將兵，外交諸侯，且欲入為亂矣。」
units.en: Ever since the crown prince took up residence at Chengfu, he has commanded troops, maintained outside relations with the feudal lords, and is now intending to enter the capital and raise disorder."
units.literal: Since the crown prince dwells in Chengfu, commands troops, associates with the feudal lords abroad, and moreover wishes to return and stir up rebellion.'

units.zh: 平王乃召其太傅伍奢考問之。
units.en: King Ping therefore summoned Wu She, the crown prince's Grand Tutor, and questioned him.
units.literal: King Ping then summoned his grand tutor Wu She to interrogate him.

units.zh: 伍奢知無忌讒太子於平王，因曰：「王獨柰何以讒賊小臣疏骨肉之親乎？」
units.en: Wu She knew Wuji was slandering the crown prince to King Ping, so he said: 'Why must Your Majesty listen to a slanderous, traitorous petty official and estrange your own flesh-and-blood kin?'
units.literal: Wu She knew Wuji was slandering the crown prince to King Ping, so said: 'Why must Your Majesty alone yield to a slanderous, traitorous petty official and estrange your own flesh-and-blood kin?'

units.zh: 無忌曰：「王今不制，其事成矣。
units.en: Wuji said: "If Your Majesty does not check him now, his plot will succeed.
units.literal: Wuji said: 'If the king does not control this now, the matter will succeed.

units.zh: 王且見禽。」
units.en: The king will soon be captured.'
units.literal: The king will soon be captured.'

units.zh: 於是平王怒，囚伍奢，而使城父司馬奮揚往殺太子。
units.en: Then King Ping was angry, imprisoned Wu She, and sent the Chengfu commander Fu Yang to go kill the crown prince.
units.literal: Then King Ping was angry, imprisoned Wu She, and sent Chengfu commander Fu Yang to go kill the crown prince.

units.zh: 行未至，奮揚使人先告太子：「太子急去，不然將誅。」
units.en: Before arriving, Fu Yang sent someone to first warn the crown prince: 'Crown prince, flee quickly, otherwise you will be executed.'
units.literal: Before arriving, Fu Yang sent someone to first warn the crown prince: 'Crown prince flee quickly, otherwise will be executed.'

units.zh: 太子建亡奔宋。
units.en: Crown Prince Jian fled to Song.
units.literal: Crown Prince Jian fled to Song.

units.zh: 無忌言於平王曰：「伍奢有二子，皆賢，不誅且為楚憂。
units.en: Wuji spoke to King Ping, saying: 'Wu She has two sons, both worthy. If not executed, they will be a worry for Chu.
units.literal: Wuji spoke to King Ping saying: 'Wu She has two sons, both worthy, if not executed will be a worry for Chu.

units.zh: 可以其父質而召之，不然且為楚患。」
units.en: Use their father as a hostage to summon them. Otherwise, they will become a calamity for Chu.'
units.literal: Can use their father as hostage and summon them, otherwise will become a calamity for Chu.'

units.zh: 王使使謂伍奢曰：「能致汝二子則生，不能則死。」
units.en: The king sent an envoy to tell Wu She: 'If you can bring your two sons, then live; if you cannot, then die.'
units.literal: The king sent an envoy to tell Wu She: 'If you can bring your two sons then live, if cannot then die.'

units.zh: 伍奢曰：「尚為人仁，呼必來。
units.en: Wu She said: 'Shang is humane in character. If called, he will certainly come.
units.literal: Wu She said: 'Shang is humane in character, if called will certainly come.

units.zh: 員為人剛戾忍訽，能成大事，彼見來之并禽，其勢必不來。」
units.en: Yuan is fierce and unyielding. He can endure humiliation and accomplish great things. Once he sees that coming means both brothers will be captured, he certainly will not come.'
units.literal: Yuan is fierce and harsh in character, can endure humiliation, can accomplish great matters, he seeing that coming means both captured, the situation certainly will not come.'

units.zh: 王不聽，使人召二子曰：「來，吾生汝父；
units.en: The king did not listen and sent someone to summon the two sons, saying: 'Come, I will let your father live;
units.literal: The king did not listen, sent someone to summon the two sons saying: 'Come, I will let your father live;

units.zh: 不來，今殺奢也。」
units.en: if you do not come, I will kill She now.'
units.literal: If not come, now kill She.'

units.zh: 伍尚欲往，員曰：「楚之召我兄弟，非欲以生我父也，恐有脫者後生患，故以父為質，詐召二子。
units.en: Wu Shang wished to go, but Yuan said: 'Chu's summoning of us brothers is not to let our father live. They fear that escapees will later cause trouble, so they use our father as hostage and deceitfully summon the two sons.
units.literal: Wu Shang wished to go, Yuan said: 'Chu's summoning of us brothers is not to let our father live, fears there are escapees who will later cause trouble, therefore uses father as hostage, deceives and summons the two sons.

units.zh: 二子到，則父子俱死。
units.en: If the two sons arrive, then father and sons will all die.
units.literal: Two sons arrive, then father and sons all die.

units.zh: 何益父之死？
units.en: What good would that do for our father's death?
units.literal: What benefit father's death?

units.zh: 往而令讎不得報耳。
units.en: Going would just mean that the enemy cannot be avenged.
units.literal: Going just lets the enemy not be avenged.

units.zh: 不如奔他國，借力以雪父之恥，俱滅，無為也。」
units.en: Better to flee to another state, borrow strength to avenge father's humiliation. Being extinguished together would be of no benefit.'
units.literal: Better to flee to another state, borrow strength to avenge father's humiliation, together extinguished, no benefit.'

units.zh: 伍尚曰：「我知往終不能全父命。
units.en: Wu Shang said: 'I know that going ultimately cannot save our father's life.
units.literal: Wu Shang said: 'I know going ultimately cannot save father's life.

units.zh: 然恨父召我以求生而不往，後不能雪恥，終為天下笑耳。」
units.en: But if our father summoned me in hope of living, and I did not go, and afterward I could not avenge the humiliation, I would become the laughingstock of the world.'
units.literal: But hate that father summoned me seeking life and not go, later cannot avenge humiliation, ultimately become world's laughingstock.'

units.zh: 謂員：「可去矣！
units.en: He told Yuan: 'You can go!
units.literal: Told Yuan: 'You can go!

units.zh: 汝能報殺父之讎，我將歸死。」
units.en: If you can avenge our father's murder, I will return and face death."
units.literal: If you can avenge killing father's enemy, I will return and die.'

units.zh: 尚既就執，使者捕伍胥。
units.en: Shang having been captured, the envoy then tried to capture Wu Zixu.
units.literal: Shang having been captured, the envoy then tried to capture Wu Zixu.

units.zh: 伍胥貫弓執矢向使者，使者不敢進，伍胥遂亡。
units.en: Wu Zixu strung his bow and held arrows pointing at the envoy. The envoy dared not advance, so Wu Zixu then fled.
units.literal: Wu Zixu strung his bow and held arrows pointing at the envoy, the envoy dared not advance, Wu Zixu then fled.

units.zh: 聞太子建之在宋，往從之。
units.en: He heard that Crown Prince Jian was in Song, so he went to follow him.
units.literal: Heard Crown Prince Jian was in Song, went to follow him.

units.zh: 奢聞子胥之亡也，曰：「楚國君臣且苦兵矣。」
units.en: When Wu She heard that Zixu had fled, he said: "The ruler and ministers of Chu will soon suffer the hardships of war."
units.literal: He heard of Zixu's flight and said: 'Chu's ruler and ministers will soon suffer from warfare.'

units.zh: 伍尚至楚，楚并殺奢與尚也。
units.en: Wu Shang arrived in Chu, and Chu executed both She and Shang.
units.literal: Wu Shang arrived in Chu, Chu executed both She and Shang.

units.zh: 伍胥既至宋，宋有華氏之亂，乃與太子建俱奔於鄭。
units.en: After Wu Zixu reached Song, the Hua clan rebellion broke out there, so he and Crown Prince Jian fled together to Zheng.
units.literal: Wu Zixu having arrived in Song, Song had the Hua clan rebellion, so together with Crown Prince Jian fled to Zheng.

units.zh: 鄭人甚善之。
units.en: The Zheng people treated them very well.
units.literal: The Zheng people treated them very well.

units.zh: 太子建又適晉，晉頃公曰：「太子既善鄭，鄭信太子。
units.en: Crown Prince Jian again went to Jin. Duke Qing of Jin said: 'The crown prince is on good terms with Zheng, and Zheng trusts the crown prince.
units.literal: Crown Prince Jian again went to Jin, Duke Qing of Jin said: 'The crown prince is on good terms with Zheng, Zheng trusts the crown prince.

units.zh: 太子能為我內應，而我攻其外，滅鄭必矣。
units.en: If the crown prince can be my internal supporter while I attack from outside, extinguishing Zheng is certain.
units.literal: If the crown prince can be my internal supporter, and I attack from outside, extinguishing Zheng is certain.

units.zh: 滅鄭而封太子。」
units.en: Once Zheng is destroyed, I will enfeoff the crown prince there.'
units.literal: Extinguish Zheng and enfeoff the crown prince.'

units.zh: 太子乃還鄭。
units.en: The crown prince then returned to Zheng.
units.literal: The crown prince then returned to Zheng.

units.zh: 事未會，會自私欲殺其從者，從者知其謀，乃告之於鄭。
units.en: Before the matter could be carried out, Jian privately intended to kill his followers. They learned of his plot and reported it to Zheng.
units.literal: The matter had not yet come to pass, but Jian privately wished to kill his followers. The followers knew his plot, so they reported it to Zheng.

units.zh: 鄭定公與子產誅殺太子建。
units.en: Duke Ding of Zheng and Zichan put Crown Prince Jian to death.
units.literal: Duke Ding of Zheng and Zi Chan executed Crown Prince Jian.

units.zh: 建有子名勝。
units.en: Jian had a son named Sheng.
units.literal: Jian had a son named Sheng.

units.zh: 伍胥懼，乃與勝俱奔吳。
units.en: Wu Zixu feared, so together with Sheng he fled to Wu.
units.literal: Wu Zixu feared, so together with Sheng fled to Wu.

units.zh: 到昭關，昭關欲執之。
units.en: They arrived at Zhao Pass, where the guards wished to capture them.
units.literal: Arrived at Zhao Pass, Zhao Pass wished to capture them.

units.zh: 伍胥遂與勝獨身步走，幾不得脫。
units.en: Wu Zixu then fled on foot with Sheng alone and nearly failed to escape.
units.literal: Wu Zixu then with Sheng alone on foot fled, almost could not escape.

units.zh: 追者在後。
units.en: Pursuers were behind them.
units.literal: Pursuers behind.

units.zh: 至江，江上有一漁父乘船，知伍胥之急，乃渡伍胥。
units.en: They reached the Jiang, where a fisherman in a boat saw Wu Zixu's urgency and ferried him across.
units.literal: Arrived at the Jiang, on the Jiang there was a fisherman in a boat, knew Wu Zixu urgency, so ferried Wu Zixu.

units.zh: 伍胥既渡，解其劍曰：「此劍直百金，以與父。」
units.en: After Wu Zixu crossed, he unfastened his sword and said: 'This sword is worth a hundred in gold. I give it to you, elder.'
units.literal: After Wu Zixu had crossed, he unfastened his sword and said, "This sword is worth a hundred in gold; I give it to you, elder."

units.zh: 父曰：「楚國之法，得伍胥者賜粟五萬石，爵執珪，豈徒百金劍邪！」
units.en: The fisherman said: 'Under Chu law, whoever captures Wu Zixu receives fifty thousand shi of grain and the rank of Holder of the Jade Tablet. Why would I care for a sword worth merely a hundred in gold?'
units.literal: The elder said, "Under Chu law, whoever captures Wu Zixu is granted fifty thousand shi of grain and the rank of Holder of the Jade Tablet. Why would I care for a sword worth merely a hundred in gold?"

units.zh: 不受。
units.en: He did not accept.
units.literal: Did not accept.

units.zh: 伍胥未至吳而疾，止中道，乞食。
units.en: Before Wu Zixu reached Wu, he fell ill, stopped along the road, and begged for food.
units.literal: Wu Zixu not yet arrived Wu fell ill, stopped midway, begged food.

units.zh: 至於吳，吳王僚方用事，公子光為將。
units.en: He arrived in Wu, where King Liao of Wu was in power and Prince Guang was general.
units.literal: Arrived Wu, King Liao of Wu in power, Prince Guang general.

units.zh: 伍胥乃因公子光以求見吳王。
units.en: Wu Zixu then sought an audience with the King of Wu through Prince Guang.
units.literal: Wu Zixu then through Prince Guang sought audience King Wu.

units.zh: 久之，楚平王以其邊邑鐘離與吳邊邑卑梁氏俱蠶，兩女子爭桑相攻，乃大怒，至於兩國舉兵相伐。
units.en: Some time later, people from Zhongli, a Chu border town, and the Bei Liang clan, a Wu border settlement, were both tending silkworms. Two women quarreled over mulberry leaves and came to blows. The dispute enraged both sides, until the two states raised troops against each other.
units.literal: After long time, King Ping Chu with his border town Zhongli and Wu border town Bei Liang clan both sericulture, two women quarreled mulberry attacked each other, greatly angered, extent both states raised troops invade each other.

units.zh: 吳使公子光伐楚，拔其鐘離、居巢而歸。
units.en: Wu sent Prince Guang to attack Chu. He captured Zhongli and Ju Chao, then returned.
units.literal: Wu sent Prince Guang attack Chu, captured their Zhongli, Ju Chao returned.

units.zh: 伍子胥說吳王僚曰：「楚可破也。
units.en: Wu Zixu advised King Liao of Wu, saying: 'Chu can be broken.
units.literal: Wu Zixu advised King Liao Wu saying: "Chu can broken.

units.zh: 願復遣公子光。」
units.en: I wish to send Prince Guang again.'
units.literal: Wish again send Prince Guang."

units.zh: 公子光謂吳王曰：「彼伍胥父兄為戮於楚，而勸王伐楚者，欲以自報其讎耳。
units.en: Prince Guang told the King of Wu: 'Wu Zixu's father and elder brother were slaughtered by Chu. He advises Your Majesty to attack Chu only because he wants to avenge his private grievance.
units.literal: Prince Guang told King Wu: "That Wu Zixu father elder brother slaughtered by Chu, advises king attack Chu, desires personally avenge his enmity.

units.zh: 伐楚未可破也。」
units.en: Chu cannot yet be broken by an attack.'
units.literal: Attack Chu; it cannot yet be broken.'

units.zh: 伍胥知公子光有內志，欲殺王而自立，未可說以外事，乃進專諸於公子光，退而與太子建之子勝耕於野。
units.en: Wu Zixu knew Prince Guang harbored ambitions within Wu and intended to kill the king and establish himself. Since Guang could not yet be persuaded about campaigns abroad, Zixu introduced Zhuan Zhu to him, then withdrew to farm in the fields with Sheng, the son of Crown Prince Jian.
units.literal: Wu Zixu knew Prince Guang had inner ambitions, wished kill king establish himself, could not advise external matters, introduced Zhuan Zhu to Prince Guang, withdrew with Crown Prince Jian son Sheng farmed fields.

units.zh: 五年而楚平王卒。
units.en: Five years later, King Ping of Chu died.
units.literal: Five years King Ping Chu died.

units.zh: 初，平王所奪太子建秦女生子軫，及平王卒，軫竟立為後，是為昭王。
units.en: Initially, the Qin woman whom King Ping had seized from Crown Prince Jian gave birth to a son named Zhen. When King Ping died, Zhen was finally established as heir. This was King Zhao.
units.literal: Initially, King Ping seized Crown Prince Jian Qin woman gave birth son Zhen, King Ping died, Zhen finally established heir, this King Zhao.

units.zh: 吳王僚因楚喪，使二公子將兵往襲楚。
units.en: King Liao of Wu took advantage of Chu's mourning and sent two princes to lead troops and invade Chu.
units.literal: King Liao Wu took advantage Chu mourning, sent two princes lead troops invade Chu.

units.zh: 楚發兵絕吳兵之後，不得歸。
units.en: Chu sent troops to cut off the rear of the Wu troops, so they could not return.
units.literal: Chu sent troops cut Wu troops rear, could not return.

units.zh: 吳國內空，而公子光乃令專諸襲刺吳王僚而自立，是為吳王闔廬。
units.en: Wu's interior was empty, so Prince Guang ordered Zhuan Zhu to assassinate King Liao of Wu and establish himself. This was King Helü of Wu.
units.literal: Wu state interior empty, Prince Guang ordered Zhuan Zhu assassinate King Liao Wu established himself, this King Helü Wu.

units.zh: 闔廬既立，得志，乃召伍員以為行人，而與謀國事。
units.en: Once Helü had taken the throne and achieved his ambition, he summoned Wu Yun to serve as envoy and planned affairs of state with him.
units.literal: Once Helü had taken the throne and achieved his ambition, he summoned Wu Yun to serve as envoy and planned affairs of state with him.

units.zh: 楚誅其大臣郤宛、伯州犁，伯州犁之孫伯嚭亡奔吳，吳亦以嚭為大夫。
units.en: Chu executed its ministers Xi Wan and Bo Zhouli. Bo Zhouli's grandson Bo Pi fled to Wu, where Wu also made him a grandee.
units.literal: Chu executed its ministers Xi Wan, Bo Zhou Li, Bo Zhou Li grandson Bo Pi fled Wu, Wu also made Pi grand master.

units.zh: 前王僚所遣二公子將兵伐楚者，道絕不得歸。
units.en: The two princes whom the former King Liao had sent to lead troops and attack Chu had their way cut off and could not return.
units.literal: Former King Liao sent two princes lead troops attack Chu, way cut could not return.

units.zh: 後聞闔廬弒王僚自立，遂以其兵降楚，楚封之於舒。
units.en: Later they heard that Helü had assassinated King Liao and established himself, so they surrendered their troops to Chu. Chu enfeoffed them at Shu.
units.literal: Later heard Helü assassinated King Liao self-established, then their troops surrendered Chu, Chu enfeoffed them Shu.

units.zh: 闔廬立三年，乃興師與伍胥、伯嚭伐楚，拔舒，遂禽故吳反二將軍。
units.en: Three years after Helü was established, he raised troops and with Wu Zixu and Bo Pi attacked Chu. He captured Shu and captured the two former Wu generals who had rebelled.
units.literal: Helü established three years, raised troops with Wu Zixu, Bo Pi attacked Chu, captured Shu, captured former Wu rebel two generals.

units.zh: 因欲至郢，將軍孫武曰：「民勞，未可，且待之。」
units.en: He then wished to press on to Ying, but General Sun Wu said: 'The people are exhausted. It cannot be done yet. Wait a little longer.'
units.literal: Wished go Ying, General Sun Wu said: "People weary, not yet can, moreover wait."

units.zh: 乃歸。
units.en: They then returned.
units.literal: Then returned.

units.zh: 四年，吳伐楚，取六與灊。
units.en: In the fourth year, Wu attacked Chu and took Liu and Qian.
units.literal: Fourth year, Wu attacked Chu, took Liu and Qian.

units.zh: 五年，伐越，敗之。
units.en: In the fifth year, they attacked Yue and defeated them.
units.literal: Fifth year, attacked Yue, defeated them.

units.zh: 六年，楚昭王使公子囊瓦將兵伐吳。
units.en: In the sixth year, King Zhao of Chu sent Prince Nang Wa to lead troops and attack Wu.
units.literal: Sixth year, King Zhao Chu sent Prince Nang Wa lead troops attack Wu.

units.zh: 吳使伍員迎擊，大破楚軍於豫章，取楚之居巢。
units.en: Wu sent Wu Zixu to meet and attack them. He greatly defeated the Chu army at Yu Zhang and took Chu's Ju Chao.
units.literal: Wu sent Wu Zixu meet attack, greatly defeated Chu army Yu Zhang, took Chu Ju Chao.

units.zh: 九年，吳王闔廬謂子胥、孫武曰：「始子言郢未可入，今果何如？」
units.en: In the ninth year, King Helü of Wu told Wu Zixu and Sun Wu: 'Initially you said Ying could not be entered. Now indeed, how is it?'
units.literal: Ninth year, King Helü Wu told Wu Zixu, Sun Wu: "Initially you said Ying not enter, now indeed how?"

units.zh: 二子對曰：「楚將囊瓦貪，而唐、蔡皆怨之。
units.en: The two replied: 'The Chu general Nang Wa is greedy, and Tang and Cai all resent him.
units.literal: Two replied: "Chu general Nang Wa greedy, Tang, Cai all resent him.

units.zh: 王必欲大伐之，必先得唐、蔡乃可。」
units.en: If the king insists on launching a major attack, he must first secure Tang and Cai. Only then can it be done.'
units.literal: King must greatly attack, must first get Tang, Cai then can."

units.zh: 闔廬聽之，悉興師與唐、蔡伐楚，與楚夾漢水而陳。
units.en: Helü listened to them. He raised all his troops and attacked Chu together with Tang and Cai. They lined up against Chu across the Han River.
units.literal: Helü listened, completely raised troops with Tang, Cai attacked Chu, with Chu lined across Han water.

units.zh: 吳王之弟夫概將兵請從，王不聽，遂以其屬五千人擊楚將子常。
units.en: The Wu king's younger brother Fu Gai led troops and asked to join the campaign. The king refused, so Fu Gai took five thousand of his own followers and attacked the Chu general Zichang.
units.literal: Wu king younger brother Fu Gai led troops requested follow, king not listened, then his followers five thousand attacked Chu general Zi Chang.

units.zh: 己卯，楚昭王出奔。
units.en: On jimao day, King Zhao of Chu fled.
units.literal: jimao, King Zhao Chu fled.

units.zh: 庚辰，吳王入郢。
units.en: On gengchen day, the Wu king entered Ying.
units.literal: gengchen, King Wu entered Ying.

units.zh: 子常敗走，奔鄭。
units.en: Zi Chang was defeated and fled to Zheng.
units.literal: Zi Chang defeated fled, went Zheng.

units.zh: 於是吳乘勝而前，五戰，遂至郢。
units.en: Then Wu took advantage of their victory and advanced. After five battles, they arrived at Ying.
units.literal: Then Wu took advantage victory advanced, five battles, arrived Ying.

units.zh: 昭王出亡，入雲夢；
units.en: King Zhao fled and entered Yun Meng;
units.literal: King Zhao fled, entered Yun Meng;

units.zh: 盜擊王，王走鄖。
units.en: Bandits attacked the king, so the king fled to Yun.
units.literal: Bandits attacked the king; the king fled to Yun.

units.zh: 鄖公弟懷曰：「平王殺我父，我殺其子，不亦可乎！」
units.en: The Duke of Yun's younger brother Huai said: 'King Ping killed my father. If I kill his son, would that not also be acceptable!'
units.literal: Yun duke younger brother Huai said: "King Ping killed my father, I kill his son, not also can!"

units.zh: 鄖公恐其弟殺王，與王奔隨。
units.en: The Duke of Yun feared his younger brother would kill the king, so he fled to Sui with the king.
units.literal: Yun duke feared his younger brother kill king, with king fled Sui.

units.zh: 吳兵圍隨，謂隨人曰：「周之子孫在漢川者，楚盡滅之。」
units.en: Wu troops surrounded Sui and told the Sui people: 'The Zhou descendants in the Han region: Chu has wiped them out.'
units.literal: Wu troops surrounded Sui, told Sui people: "Zhou descendants in Han region, Chu completely extinguished them."

units.zh: 隨人欲殺王，王子綦匿王，己自為王以當之。
units.en: The Sui people wished to kill the king. Prince Qi hid the king and himself became king to take his place.
units.literal: Sui people wished to kill king, Prince Qi hid king, himself became king to block it.

units.zh: 隨人卜與王於吳，不吉，乃謝吳不與王。
units.en: The Sui people divined giving the king to Wu. It was not auspicious, so they declined Wu and did not give the king.
units.literal: Sui people divined give king to Wu, not auspicious, then declined Wu not give king.

units.zh: 始伍員與申包胥為交，員之亡也，謂包胥曰：「我必覆楚。」
units.en: Initially Wu Zixu and Shen Bao Xu were friends. When Zixu fled, he told Bao Xu: 'I must overturn Chu.'
units.literal: Initially Wu Zixu with Shen Bao Xu were friends, Zixu fled, told Bao Xu: "I must overturn Chu."

units.zh: 包胥曰：「我必存之。」
units.en: Bao Xu said: 'I must preserve it.'
units.literal: Bao Xu said: "I must preserve it."

units.zh: 及吳兵入郢，伍子胥求昭王。
units.en: When Wu's troops entered Ying, Wu Zixu searched for King Zhao.
units.literal: When Wu troops entered Ying, Wu Zixu sought King Zhao.

units.zh: 既不得，乃掘楚平王墓，出其尸，鞭之三百，然後已。
units.en: Unable to find him, Wu Zixu dug up King Ping of Chu's tomb, dragged out the corpse, and whipped it three hundred times before stopping.
units.literal: Having not obtained, then dug King Ping of Chu tomb, removed his corpse, whipped it three hundred times, then stopped.

units.zh: 申包胥亡於山中，使人謂子胥曰：「子之報讎，其以甚乎！
units.en: Shen Baoxu fled into the mountains and sent someone to tell Wu Zixu: 'Has your revenge not gone too far?
units.literal: Shen Bao Xu fled mountain midst, sent person tell Wu Zixu: "Your avenging enmity, is it excessive!

units.zh: 吾聞之，人眾者勝天，天定亦能破人。
units.en: I have heard that when people are many, they can overcome Heaven; but when Heaven's decree is fixed, it too can break men.
units.literal: I have heard: the many can overcome heaven; where heaven has determined, people also can break it.

units.zh: 今子故平王之臣，親北面而事之，今至於僇死人，此豈其無天道之極乎！」
units.en: You were once King Ping's minister and personally served him, facing north before his throne. Now you have gone so far as to mutilate a dead man. Is this not the utmost violation of Heaven's Way?'
units.literal: Now you were formerly King Ping's minister and personally served him facing north. Now you have come to whipping a dead man. How can this not be the extreme of heaven's way!'

units.zh: 伍子胥曰：「為我謝申包胥曰，吾日莫途遠，吾故倒行而逆施之。」
units.en: Wu Zixu said: 'Offer my apologies to Shen Baoxu and tell him: The sun is setting, and the road is long, so I must walk backward and act against the usual order.'
units.literal: Wu Zixu said: 'Offer my apologies to Shen Baoxu and tell him: The sun is setting and the road is long, so I must walk backward and act against the usual order.'

units.zh: 於是申包胥走秦告急，求救於秦。
units.en: Then Shen Baoxu went to Qin to report the emergency and seek aid.
units.literal: Then Shen Bao Xu went Qin report urgent, sought aid from Qin.

units.zh: 秦不許。
units.en: Qin refused.
units.literal: Qin not permitted.

units.zh: 包胥立於秦廷，晝夜哭，七日七夜不絕其聲。
units.en: Baoxu stood in the Qin court and wept day and night. For seven days and seven nights his cries did not cease.
units.literal: Bao Xu stood Qin court, day night cried, seven days seven nights not ceased sound.

units.zh: 秦哀公憐之，曰：「楚雖無道，有臣若是，可無存乎！」
units.en: Duke Ai of Qin pitied him and said: 'Though Chu has lost the Way, it has a minister like this. How could it not be preserved?'
units.literal: Qin Ai Gong pitied him, said: "Chu though no way, has minister like this, can no preserve?"

units.zh: 乃遣車五百乘救楚擊吳。
units.en: He then sent five hundred chariots to save Chu and attack Wu.
units.literal: Then sent five hundred chariots save Chu attack Wu.

units.zh: 六月，敗吳兵於稷。
units.en: In the sixth month, they defeated the Wu troops at Ji.
units.literal: Sixth month, defeated Wu troops at Ji.

units.zh: 會吳王久留楚求昭王，而闔廬弟夫概乃亡歸，自立為王。
units.en: It happened that the Wu king stayed long in Chu seeking King Zhao, while Helü's younger brother Fu Gai fled back and established himself as king.
units.literal: Met Wu king long stayed Chu sought King Zhao, Helü younger brother Fu Gai fled returned, self-established as king.

units.zh: 闔廬聞之，乃釋楚而歸，擊其弟夫概。
units.en: When Helü heard this, he abandoned the campaign in Chu and returned to attack his younger brother Fu Gai.
units.literal: Helü heard it, then released Chu returned, attacked his younger brother Fu Gai.

units.zh: 夫概敗走，遂奔楚。
units.en: Fu Gai was defeated and fled, then went to Chu.
units.literal: Fu Gai defeated fled, then went Chu.

units.zh: 楚昭王見吳有內亂，乃復入郢。
units.en: King Zhao of Chu saw that Wu was in internal disorder, so he returned to Ying.
units.literal: King Zhao of Chu saw Wu had internal chaos, then again entered Ying.

units.zh: 封夫概於堂谿，為堂谿氏。
units.en: He enfeoffed Fu Gai at Tangxi, and Fu Gai became ancestor of the Tangxi clan.
units.literal: Enfeoffed Fu Gai at Tang Xi, became Tang Xi clan.

units.zh: 楚復與吳戰，敗吳，吳王乃歸。
units.en: Chu again battled Wu, defeated Wu, and the Wu king then returned.
units.literal: Chu again battled Wu, defeated Wu, Wu king then returned.

units.zh: 後二歲，闔廬使太子夫差將兵伐楚，取番。
units.en: After two years, Helü made Crown Prince Fu Chai lead troops to attack Chu and took Fan.
units.literal: After two years, Helü made crown prince Fu Chai lead troops attack Chu, took Fan.

units.zh: 楚懼吳復大來，乃去郢，徙於鄀。
units.en: Chu feared that Wu would return in force, so it abandoned Ying and moved to Ruo.
units.literal: Chu feared Wu again greatly come, then left Ying, moved to Ruo.

units.zh: 當是時，吳以伍子胥、孫武之謀，西破彊楚，北威齊晉，南服越人。
units.en: At this time, Wu used the strategies of Wu Zixu and Sun Wu to break mighty Chu in the west, overawe Qi and Jin in the north, and subdue the Yue people in the south.
units.literal: At this time, Wu with Wu Zixu, Sun Wu strategy, west broke strong Chu, north awed Qi Jin, south subjugated Yue people.

units.zh: 其後四年，孔子相魯。
units.en: Four years later, Confucius became chancellor of Lu.
units.literal: Its after four years, Confucius chancellor Lu.

units.zh: 後五年，伐越。
units.en: After five years, they attacked Yue.
units.literal: After five years, attacked Yue.

units.zh: 越王句踐迎擊，敗吳於姑蘇，傷闔廬指，軍卻。
units.en: King Goujian of Yue met them in battle, defeated Wu at Gusu, wounded Helü's finger, and forced the army to retreat.
units.literal: King Gou Jian of Yue welcomed attacked, defeated Wu at Gu Su, wounded Helü finger, army retreated.

units.zh: 闔廬病創將死，謂太子夫差曰：「爾忘句踐殺爾父乎？」
units.en: Helü, ill from his wound and about to die, told Crown Prince Fu Chai: 'Do you forget that Goujian killed your father?'
units.literal: Helü ill from wound about to die, told crown prince Fu Chai: "You forget Gou Jian killed your father?"

units.zh: 夫差對曰：「不敢忘。」
units.en: Fu Chai replied: 'I dare not forget.'
units.literal: Fu Chai replied: "Dare not forget."

units.zh: 是夕，闔廬死。
units.en: That night, Helü died.
units.literal: This night, Helü died.

units.zh: 夫差既立為王，以伯嚭為太宰，習戰射。
units.en: After Fuchai became king, he made Bo Pi grand steward and drilled his troops in warfare and archery.
units.literal: Fu Chai established as king, made Bo Pi grand steward, practiced battle archery.

units.zh: 二年後伐越，敗越於夫湫。
units.en: After two years, he attacked Yue and defeated Yue at Fu Qiu.
units.literal: After two years attacked Yue, defeated Yue at Fu Qiu.

units.zh: 越王句踐乃以餘兵五千人棲於會稽之上，使大夫種厚幣遺吳太宰嚭以請和，求委國為臣妾。
units.en: King Goujian of Yue then withdrew with his remaining five thousand troops to Mount Kuaiji. He had the grandee Zhong send rich gifts to Wu's grand steward Pi to request peace, offering to hand over his state and serve as a vassal.
units.literal: King Gou Jian of Yue then with remaining troops five thousand dwelt atop Kui Ji, made grand master Zhong thick bribes send Wu grand steward Pi to request peace, sought to entrust state as minister concubine.

units.zh: 吳王將許之。
units.en: The Wu king was about to agree.
units.literal: Wu king about to permit it.

units.zh: 伍子胥諫曰：「越王為人能辛苦。
units.en: Wu Zixu remonstrated: 'King Goujian is a man who can endure hardship.
units.literal: Wu Zixu remonstrated: "King Gou Jian character able hardship.

units.zh: 今王不滅，後必悔之。」
units.en: If Your Majesty does not destroy him now, you will surely regret it later.'
units.literal: Now king not extinguish, later must regret."

units.zh: 吳王不聽，用太宰嚭計，與越平。
units.en: The Wu king did not listen and used Grand Steward Pi's plan to make peace with Yue.
units.literal: Wu king not listened, used grand steward Pi plan, made peace with Yue.

units.zh: 其後五年，而吳王聞齊景公死而大臣爭寵，新君弱，乃興師北伐齊。
units.en: Five years later, the Wu king heard that Duke Jing of Qi had died and ministers were contending for favor, with the new ruler weak. He raised troops and attacked Qi to the north.
units.literal: Its after five years, Wu king heard Qi Jing Gong died ministers contended favor, new jun weak, raised troops north attacked Qi.

units.zh: 伍子胥諫曰：「句踐食不重味，弔死問疾，且欲有所用之也。
units.en: Wu Zixu remonstrated: 'Goujian eats no second dish, mourns the dead and visits the sick. He means to put all this to use.
units.literal: Wu Zixu remonstrated: "Gou Jian eats not double flavors, mourns dead asks ill, moreover wishes use them.

units.zh: 此人不死，必為吳患。
units.en: If this man is not killed, he will surely become a calamity for Wu.
units.literal: This person not die, must become Wu calamity.

units.zh: 今吳之有越，猶人之有腹心疾也。
units.en: For Wu to have Yue beside it is like a man carrying a disease in his heart and belly.
units.literal: Now for Wu to have Yue is like a person having a disease of the heart and viscera.

units.zh: 而王不先越而乃務齊，不亦謬乎！」
units.en: Yet Your Majesty does not deal with Yue first, and instead devotes himself to Qi. Is this not a mistake?'
units.literal: King not first Yue but strives Qi, not also mistaken?"

units.zh: 吳王不聽，伐齊，大敗齊師於艾陵，遂威鄒魯之君以歸。
units.en: The Wu king did not listen and attacked Qi. He greatly defeated the Qi troops at Ailing, then awed the rulers of Zou and Lu and returned.
units.literal: Wu king not listened, attacked Qi, greatly defeated Qi troops at Ai Ling, then awed Zou Lu jun returned.

units.zh: 益疏子胥之謀。
units.en: He became increasingly estranged from Zixu's counsel.
units.literal: He became increasingly estranged from Zixu's counsel.

units.zh: 其後四年，吳王將北伐齊，越王句踐用子貢之謀，乃率其眾以助吳，而重寶以獻遺太宰嚭。
units.en: Four years later, when the Wu king was about to attack Qi to the north, King Goujian of Yue used Zi Gong's strategy. He led his multitudes to help Wu and offered heavy treasures to Grand Steward Pi.
units.literal: Its after four years, Wu king will north attack Qi, King Gou Jian of Yue used Zi Gong strategy, led his multitudes help Wu, heavy treasures offered grand steward Pi.

units.zh: 太宰嚭既數受越賂，其愛信越殊甚，日夜為言於吳王。
units.en: Grand Steward Pi, having several times received Yue's bribes, loved and trusted Yue extremely. Day and night he spoke on their behalf to the Wu king.
units.literal: Grand steward Pi already several received Yue bribes, loved trusted Yue extremely, day night spoke at Wu king.

units.zh: 吳王信用嚭之計。
units.en: The Wu king trusted and used Pi's plans.
units.literal: Wu king trusted used Pi plan.

units.zh: 伍子胥諫曰：「夫越，腹心之病，今信其浮辭詐偽而貪齊。
units.en: Wu Zixu remonstrated: "Yue is an abdominal heart disease. Now the king believes their empty words and deception while being greedy for Qi.
units.literal: Wu Zixu remonstrated: "Yue, abdominal heart disease, now believe their empty words deception greedy Qi.

units.zh: 破齊，譬猶石田，無所用之。
units.en: Breaking Qi is like a stone field—nothing can be used from it.
units.literal: Break Qi, like stone field, nothing use.

units.zh: 且盤庚之誥曰：『有顛越不恭，劓殄滅之，俾無遺育，無使易種于茲邑。』
units.en: Moreover, Pan Geng's admonition said: 'Those who have overturning disrespect, cut them off and extinguish them. Make no remaining descendants, do not allow changing the seed in this city.'
units.literal: Moreover, Pan Geng admonition said: "Have overturning not respectful, cut off extinguish them, make no remaining descendants, no make change seed at this yi."

units.zh: 此商之所以興。
units.en: This is why Shang rose.
units.literal: This Shang so rose.

units.zh: 願王釋齊而先越；
units.en: I wish the king to release Qi and put Yue first;
units.literal: Wish king release Qi first Yue;

units.zh: 若不然，後將悔之無及。」
units.en: if not, later you will regret it without being able to reach it."
units.literal: If not so, later will regret without reach."

units.zh: 而吳王不聽，使子胥於齊。
units.en: The Wu king did not listen and sent Wu Zixu to Qi.
units.literal: Wu king not listened, sent Wu Zixu to Qi.

units.zh: 子胥臨行，謂其子曰：「吾數諫王，王不用，吾今見吳之亡矣。
units.en: As he was about to depart, Wu Zixu told his son: 'I have repeatedly remonstrated with the king, but he has rejected my advice. I can now see that Wu will perish.
units.literal: Wu Zixu about to depart, told his son: "I several remonstrated king, king not used, I now see Wu perish.

units.zh: 汝與吳俱亡，無益也。」
units.en: For you to perish together with Wu would be of no benefit.'
units.literal: You with Wu together perish, no benefit."

units.zh: 乃屬其子於齊鮑牧，而還報吳。
units.en: He then entrusted his son to Bao Mu of Qi and returned to report to Wu.
units.literal: Then entrusted his son to Qi Bao Mu, returned reported Wu.

units.zh: 吳太宰嚭既與子胥有隙，因讒曰：「子胥為人剛暴，少恩，猜賊，其怨望恐為深禍也。
units.en: The Grand Steward Pi of Wu already had a grievance against Zixu and therefore slandered him: 'Zixu is harsh and violent, shows little kindness, and is suspicious and malicious. I fear his resentment will become a grave calamity.
units.literal: The Grand Steward Pi of Wu already had a grievance against Zixu and therefore slandered him: "Zixu is harsh and violent, shows little kindness, and is suspicious and malicious. I fear his resentment will become a grave calamity.

units.zh: 前日王欲伐齊，子胥以為不可，王卒伐之而有大功。
units.en: Previously, when the king wished to attack Qi, Zixu said it should not be done; the king ultimately attacked and won a great victory.
units.literal: Previously, when the king wished to attack Qi, Zixu said it should not be done; the king ultimately attacked and won a great victory.

units.zh: 子胥恥其計謀不用，乃反怨望。
units.en: Zixu was ashamed that his counsel had not been accepted and therefore became resentful.
units.literal: Zixu was ashamed that his counsel had not been accepted and therefore became resentful.

units.zh: 而今王又復伐齊，子胥專愎彊諫，沮毀用事，徒幸吳之敗以自勝其計謀耳。
units.en: Now that the king is attacking Qi again, Wu Zixu stubbornly remonstrates, obstructs affairs, and hopes only for Wu's defeat so that his own plans may be proved right.
units.literal: Now king again attack Qi, Wu Zixu obstinate strong remonstrated, obstructed destroyed affairs, vainly hoped Wu defeat to self win his plan.

units.zh: 今王自行，悉國中武力以伐齊，而子胥諫不用，因輟謝，詳病不行。
units.en: Now the king is going in person, using all the state's military strength to attack Qi. When Wu Zixu's remonstrations were not accepted, he withdrew, made excuses, feigned illness, and refused to go.
units.literal: Now king personally go, all state midst martial strength attack Qi, Wu Zixu remonstrated not used, because stopped declined, pretended ill not go.

units.zh: 王不可不備，此起禍不難。
units.en: Your Majesty must be on guard. It would not be difficult for him to raise disaster.
units.literal: King cannot not prepare, this raise calamity not difficult.

units.zh: 且嚭使人微伺之，其使於齊也，乃屬其子於齊之鮑氏。
units.en: Moreover, Pi made people secretly spy on him. When he was envoy to Qi, he entrusted his son to the Bao clan of Qi.
units.literal: Moreover, Pi made person secretly spy him, his envoy to Qi, entrusted his son to Qi Bao clan.

units.zh: 夫為人臣，內不得意，外倚諸侯，自以為先王之謀臣，今不見用，常鞅鞅怨望。
units.en: As a minister, he is discontent at home and relies abroad on the feudal lords. He considers himself a strategist of the former king, and now that he is not being used, he is constantly resentful.
units.literal: Being person minister, inner not content, outer relied feudal lords, self considered former king strategist, now not seen used, often vexed resented.

units.zh: 願王早圖之。」
units.en: I hope Your Majesty will make plans against him early.'
units.literal: Wish king early plan it."

units.zh: 吳王曰：「微子之言，吾亦疑之。」
units.en: The king of Wu said: "Had you not spoken, I too would have remained doubtful."
units.literal: The Wu king said: 'Without your words, I too would have suspected him.'

units.zh: 乃使使賜伍子胥屬鏤之劍，曰：「子以此死。」
units.en: He then sent an envoy to give Wu Zixu the Shulou sword, saying: 'Die with this.'
units.literal: Then sent envoy grant Wu Zixu linked sword, said: "You with this die."

units.zh: 伍子胥仰天嘆曰：「嗟乎！
units.en: Wu Zixu gazed at heaven and sighed: 'Alas!
units.literal: Wu Zixu gazed heaven sighed: "Alas!

units.zh: 讒臣嚭為亂矣，王乃反誅我。
units.en: The slanderous minister Pi has caused disorder. The king instead executes me.
units.literal: Slander minister Pi made chaos, king instead executed me.

units.zh: 我令若父霸。
units.en: I made your father a hegemon.
units.literal: I made your father hegemon.

units.zh: 自若未立時，諸公子爭立，我以死爭之於先王，幾不得立。
units.en: Before you were established, when the princes were contending for the succession, I argued for you with the former king at risk of death. You nearly did not gain the throne.
units.literal: From you not yet established, various princes contended establish, I with death contended for former king, almost not established.

units.zh: 若既得立，欲分吳國予我，我顧不敢望也。
units.en: After you gained the throne, you wished to divide the state of Wu and give me a share, yet I never dared expect such a thing.
units.literal: You having obtained establish, wished divide Wu state give me, I still dared not hope.

units.zh: 然今若聽諛臣言以殺長者。」
units.en: Yet now you listen to the words of a flattering minister and kill an elder.'
units.literal: However, now you listen flatter minister words to kill elder."

units.zh: 乃告其舍人曰：「必樹吾墓上以梓，令可以為器；
units.en: He then told his attendants: 'Plant catalpa trees above my grave, so that they may one day be made into vessels;
units.literal: Then told his attendant: "Certainly plant my grave above with catalpa, make can become vessel;

units.zh: 而抉吾眼縣吳東門之上，以觀越寇之入滅吳也。」
units.en: and dig out my eyes and hang them above Wu's eastern gate, so I may watch the Yue invaders enter and destroy Wu.'
units.literal: Dig out my eyes hang Wu east gate above, to observe Yue bandits enter extinguish Wu."

units.zh: 乃自剄死。
units.en: He then slit his own throat and died.
units.literal: Then self slit throat died.

units.zh: 吳王聞之大怒，乃取子胥尸盛以鴟夷革，浮之江中。
units.en: When the Wu king heard this, he was furious. He took Wu Zixu's corpse, sealed it in a leather wineskin, and cast it into the Jiang.
units.literal: Wu king heard greatly angered, took Wu Zixu corpse contained with Chi Yi skin, floated on Jiang midst.

units.zh: 吳人憐之，為立祠於江上，因命曰胥山。
units.en: The people of Wu pitied him. They established a shrine on the Jiang and named the place Xu Mountain.
units.literal: Wu people pitied him, established shrine on Jiang above, because named Xu Shan.

units.zh: 吳王既誅伍子胥，遂伐齊。
units.en: After executing Wu Zixu, the Wu king attacked Qi.
units.literal: Wu king having executed Wu Zixu, then attacked Qi.

units.zh: 齊鮑氏殺其君悼公而立陽生。
units.en: The Qi Bao clan killed their ruler Duke Dao and established Yang Sheng.
units.literal: Qi Bao clan killed their jun Dao Gong established Yang Sheng.

units.zh: 吳王欲討其賊，不勝而去。
units.en: The Wu king wished to punish the killers, but he failed to win and withdrew.
units.literal: Wu king wished punish their traitor, not victorious departed.

units.zh: 其後二年，吳王召魯衛之君會之橐皋。
units.en: Two years later, the Wu king summoned the rulers of Lu and Wei to assemble at Tuo Gao.
units.literal: Its after two years, Wu king summoned Lu Wei jun assembled at Tuo Gao.

units.zh: 其明年，因北大會諸侯於黃池，以令周室。
units.en: The next year, he held a great assembly of the feudal lords in the north at Huangchi, seeking to command the Zhou royal house.
units.literal: Its next year, because north great assembled feudal lords at Huang Chi, to command Zhou house.

units.zh: 越王句踐襲殺吳太子，破吳兵。
units.en: King Goujian of Yue launched a surprise attack, killed the Wu crown prince, and defeated the Wu army.
units.literal: King Gou Jian of Yue suddenly killed Wu crown prince, broke Wu troops.

units.zh: 吳王聞之，乃歸，使使厚幣與越平。
units.en: When the Wu king heard this, he returned and sent an envoy with generous gifts to make peace with Yue.
units.literal: Wu king heard it, then returned, sent envoy thick gifts made peace with Yue.

units.zh: 後九年，越王句踐遂滅吳，殺王夫差；
units.en: Nine years later, King Goujian of Yue destroyed Wu and killed King Fuchai;
units.literal: After nine years, King Gou Jian of Yue then extinguished Wu, killed king Fu Chai;

units.zh: 而誅太宰嚭，以不忠於其君，而外受重賂，與己比周也。
units.en: he also executed Grand Steward Pi, because Pi had been disloyal to his ruler, accepted heavy bribes from abroad, and conspired with him.
units.literal: Executed grand steward Pi, because not loyal to their jun, outer received heavy bribes, with self formed clique.

units.zh: 伍子胥初所與俱亡故楚太子建之子勝者，在於吳。
units.en: Sheng, the son of the former Chu Crown Prince Jian, had originally fled with Wu Zixu and was living in Wu.
units.literal: Wu Zixu initially with together fled former Chu crown prince Jian son Sheng, at Wu.

units.zh: 吳王夫差之時，楚惠王欲召勝歸楚。
units.en: During the time of King Fuchai of Wu, King Hui of Chu wished to summon Sheng back to Chu.
units.literal: Wu king Fu Chai time, Chu Hui Wang wished summon Sheng return Chu.

units.zh: 葉公諫曰：「勝好勇而陰求死士，殆有私乎！」
units.en: Ye Gong warned him: "Sheng loves bravery and is secretly recruiting men willing to die for him; he may well have private ambitions!"
units.literal: Ye Gong remonstrated: 'Sheng is fond of courage and secretly seeks men who would die for him. He probably has private designs!'

units.zh: 惠王不聽。
units.en: King Hui did not listen.
units.literal: Hui Wang not listened.

units.zh: 遂召勝，使居楚之邊邑鄢，號為白公。
units.en: He then summoned Sheng and settled him in Yan, a Chu border town, with the title Duke of Bai.
units.literal: Then summoned Sheng, made dwell Chu border yi Yan, number called Bai Gong.

units.zh: 白公歸楚三年而吳誅子胥。
units.en: Three years after Bai Gong returned to Chu, Wu executed Zixu.
units.literal: Bai Gong returned Chu three years Wu executed Xi.

units.zh: 白公勝既歸楚，怨鄭之殺其父，乃陰養死士求報鄭。
units.en: After Duke Bai Sheng returned to Chu, he nursed resentment over Zheng's killing of his father. He secretly maintained men willing to die for him, seeking revenge against Zheng.
units.literal: Bai Gong Sheng having returned Chu, resented Zheng killed his father, secretly nurtured suicide troops sought avenge Zheng.

units.zh: 歸楚五年，請伐鄭，楚令尹子西許之。
units.en: Five years after returning to Chu, he requested permission to attack Zheng. Chu's prime minister Zixi granted it.
units.literal: Returned Chu five years, requested attack Zheng, Chu prime minister Zi Xi permitted.

units.zh: 兵未發而晉伐鄭，鄭請救於楚。
units.en: Before the troops had set out, Jin attacked Zheng, and Zheng requested aid from Chu.
units.literal: Troops not issued Jin attacked Zheng, Zheng requested aid from Chu.

units.zh: 楚使子西往救，與盟而還。
units.en: Chu sent Zixi to rescue Zheng. He made an alliance with Zheng and returned.
units.literal: Chu sent Zi Xi go save, allied returned.

units.zh: 白公勝怒曰：「非鄭之仇，乃子西也。」
units.en: Duke Bai Sheng was enraged and said: 'The enemy is not Zheng, but Zixi.'
units.literal: Bai Gong Sheng angered: "Not Zheng enmity, Zi Xi."

units.zh: 勝自礪劍，人問曰：「何以為？」
units.en: Sheng personally sharpened his sword. People asked: 'What is it for?'
units.literal: Sheng self sharpened sword, people asked: "What for?"

units.zh: 勝曰：「欲以殺子西。」
units.en: Sheng said: 'I mean to kill Zixi with it.'
units.literal: Sheng said: "Wish kill Zi Xi."

units.zh: 子西聞之，笑曰：「勝如卵耳，何能為也。」
units.en: Zixi heard this and laughed, saying: 'Sheng is like an egg. What can he do?'
units.literal: Zi Xi heard, laughed: "Sheng like egg, what able do."

units.zh: 其後四歲，白公勝與石乞襲殺楚令尹子西、司馬子綦於朝。
units.en: Four years later, Duke Bai Sheng and Shi Qi made a surprise attack at court and killed Chu's prime minister Zixi and commander Ziqi.
units.literal: Its after four years, Bai Gong Sheng with Shi Qi suddenly killed Chu prime minister Zi Xi, commander Zi Qi at court.

units.zh: 石乞曰：「不殺王，不可。」
units.en: Shi Qi said: 'Unless we kill the king, this cannot succeed.'
units.literal: Shi Qi said: "Not kill king, cannot."

units.zh: 乃劫（之）王如高府。
units.en: They then coerced the king to the Gao residence.
units.literal: Then coerced king like Gao Fu.

units.zh: 石乞從者屈固負楚惠王亡走昭夫人之宮。
units.en: Shi Qi's follower Qu Gu carried King Hui of Chu on his back and fled to Lady Zhao's palace.
units.literal: Shi Qi follower Qu Gu carried Chu Hui Wang fled went Zhao Fu Ren palace.

units.zh: 葉公聞白公為亂，率其國人攻白公。
units.en: Lord Ye heard that Duke Bai had raised disorder and led the people of his domain to attack him.
units.literal: Ye Gong heard Bai Gong made chaos, led his state people attacked Bai Gong.

units.zh: 白公之徒敗，亡走山中，自殺。
units.en: Bai Gong's followers were defeated. They fled into the mountains and committed suicide.
units.literal: Bai Gong followers defeated, fled mountain midst, committed suicide.

units.zh: 而虜石乞，而問白公尸處，不言將亨。
units.en: They captured Shi Qi and questioned him about where Duke Bai's corpse was hidden, threatening to boil him if he would not speak.
units.literal: Captured Shi Qi, questioned Bai Gong corpse place, not speak would boil.

units.zh: 石乞曰：「事成為卿，不成而亨，固其職也。」
units.en: Shi Qi said: 'If the affair had succeeded, I would have become a minister. Since it failed, and I am to be boiled, that too is part of my office.'
units.literal: Shi Qi said: "Affair become qing, not become boil, certainly its duty."

units.zh: 終不肯告其尸處。
units.en: To the end, he refused to reveal where Duke Bai's corpse was.
units.literal: Finally not consented tell his corpse place.

units.zh: 遂亨石乞，而求惠王復立之。
units.en: They then boiled Shi Qi and sought out King Hui to restore him to the throne.
units.literal: Then boiled Shi Qi, sought Hui Wang again established him.

units.zh: 太史公曰：怨毒之於人甚矣哉！
units.en: The Grand Historian said: How terrible resentment and hatred are in men!
units.literal: Grand Historian said: Resentment poison at people extreme!

units.zh: 王者尚不能行之於臣下，況同列乎！
units.en: If even kings cannot indulge them toward ministers and subordinates, how much less can men of equal rank do so toward one another!
units.literal: Even kings cannot practice it toward their ministers and subordinates—how much less toward those of the same rank!

units.zh: 向令伍子胥從奢俱死，何異螻蟻。
units.en: If Wu Zixu had followed Wu She and died with him, how would he have differed from an ant?
units.literal: Towards made Wu Zixu follow She together die, what different ant.

units.zh: 棄小義，雪大恥，名垂於後世，悲夫！
units.en: He abandoned a lesser righteousness, avenged a great humiliation, and left his name to later generations. How tragic!
units.literal: Abandon small righteousness, avenge great humiliation, name hang at later generations, sad!

units.zh: 方子胥窘於江上，道乞食，志豈嘗須臾忘郢邪？
units.en: When Zixu was in distress beside the Jiang, begging for food along the road, could he have forgotten his resolve to reach Ying for even a moment?
units.literal: When Zixu was in distress beside the Jiang, begging for food along the road, could he have forgotten his resolve to reach Ying for even a moment?

units.zh: 故隱忍就功名，非烈丈夫孰能致此哉？
units.en: Thus, he hid his feelings and endured until he achieved merit and renown. Who but a fierce and resolute man could have done this?
units.literal: Therefore, concealed endured achieved merit name, not fierce husband who able reach this?

units.zh: 白公如不自立為君者，其功謀亦不可勝道者哉！
units.en: Had Duke Bai not tried to set himself up as ruler, both his achievements and his plans would have been beyond full telling!
units.literal: Bai Gong if not self established as jun, his merit plans also cannot all say!
